newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SALGUEIROS TROUNCED IN PORTUGUESE DERBY. [CORRECTED 22:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SALGUEIROS TROUNCED IN PORTUGUESE DERBY. [CORRECTED 22:47 GMT]

text.p: Portugal's Salgueiros suffered a major blow in their bid for a UEFA Cup place when they crashed 5-0 at northern neighbours Boavista on Sunday.
Nuno Gomes did the damage, scoring a hat-trick in one of his last games for the Portuguese Cup finalists before moving to Benfica next season.
With Porto already champions for a record third successive year and Sporting guaranteed second spot, interest in the championship focused on which other teams will qualify for Europe.
With just one more game (corrects from two) to play, three points separate Braga, Guimaraes and Salgueiros in the scramble for a UEFA spot.
Third-placed Benfica, beaten 3-1 at home by Porto on Friday, could be playing in the European Cup Winners' Cup -- leaving a UEFA berth vacant -- if they retain the trophy on June 10.
Guimaraes beat Beleneneses 1-0 at home with a goal after six minutes by Brazilian Gilmar Estevan. Braga missed a penalty in the 0-0 draw at Leca.
